transcript.text: May I have your name and date of birth?
Priya Example, July 7, 1978. I've been coming here for years.
Thanks, Priya. Could I also get your insurance provider and member ID?
I think it's Demo Insurance, same as last time. I don't remember the member ID.
No problem, I'll note Demo Insurance. Dr. Smith is available Monday at 10 AM or Friday at 2 PM.
You're booked for Monday at 10 AM. Goodbye.
